WITH sales_buckets AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN 'bucket1'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN 'bucket2'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN 'bucket3'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN 'bucket4'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN 'bucket5'
        END AS bucket,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid
    FROM store_sales
    GROUP BY bucket
)
SELECT
    (SELECT CASE WHEN cnt > 1071 THEN avg_ext_tax ELSE avg_net_paid END
     FROM sales_buckets
     WHERE bucket = 'bucket1') AS bucket1,
    (SELECT CASE WHEN cnt > 1071 THEN avg_ext_tax ELSE avg_net_paid END
     FROM sales_buckets
     WHERE bucket = 'bucket2') AS bucket2,
    (SELECT CASE WHEN cnt > 1071 THEN avg_ext_tax ELSE avg_net_paid END
     FROM sales_buckets
     WHERE bucket = 'bucket3') AS bucket3,
    (SELECT CASE WHEN cnt > 1071 THEN avg_ext_tax ELSE avg_net_paid END
     FROM sales_buckets
     WHERE bucket = 'bucket4') AS bucket4,
    (SELECT CASE WHEN cnt > 1071 THEN avg_ext_tax ELSE avg_net_paid END
     FROM sales_buckets
     WHERE bucket = 'bucket5') AS bucket5
FROM reason
WHERE r_reason_sk = 1
